tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the pages and articles of sw-cpas.com, including the developer, API and agent documentation. Use it to find which page answers a question; returns titles, URLs and markdown URLs, best match first. Read a result with fetch_doc.

tools.name: fetch_doc
tools.description: Return one page or article of sw-cpas.com as markdown with YAML front matter. Accepts a full URL or a path such as /dental-cpa/ or /agents.md, usually taken from search_docs results. URLs on other sites are refused.
